translation: If I could be granted more years, rubbing to free the qi and blood, so that concretions go and conglomerations disperse; sunning to divide yin and yang, so that the clear rises and the turbid descends, and the skin, bone, sinew, and flesh are renewed once, then I would not have failed this life. Now. Having gathered the discourse on rubbing, I further append the experience of the sunning method.
